verdict.rationale: Founder Law is a U.S. immigration and startup law firm selling attorney-led service packages, not a software platform where users configure storage. User-selectable data region or residency is a software/SaaS axis that does not fit this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows any user-facing data-storage configuration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
